status: Original draft scripts for review and illustration; not finished comic art
rules: Four distinct illustrated panels per comic. OPponent/PLAYER tokens resolve to the exact selected fighter. No TFW crossover, deity dialogue, magic, or recycled Celina inserts. Preserve existing character designs. Do not render scripts as completed artwork.

femur_opening_celina.title: An Uninvited Challenger
femur_opening_celina.when: Femur selected: before first fight, against Celina

panels.shot: Femur enters the Moonlit Colonnade, her boots planted on the stone. Celina stands waiting in ginga.
panels.speaker: FEMUR
panels.dialogue: I came for your school. Every student. Every champion.

panels.shot: Celina faces Femur without moving from her stance.
panels.speaker: CELINA
panels.dialogue: Then you can start with me.

panels.shot: Close on Femur, relaxed shoulders, eyes fixed on Celina.
panels.speaker: FEMUR
panels.dialogue: Good. I want them to know who challenged them first.

panels.shot: Wide shot of both combatants taking their places in the roda.
panels.speaker: CELINA
panels.dialogue: The roda will answer you.

femur_student.title: The School Answers
femur_student.when: Femur selected: before any verified student opponent other than Celina

panels.shot: The next student arrives in one of Femur's five arenas.
panels.speaker: FEMUR
panels.dialogue: Another student of Mestre Mare.

panels.shot: The student calmly assumes their own original ginga.
panels.speaker: OPPONENT
panels.dialogue: I speak for myself.

panels.shot: Femur raises her guard and steps into range.
panels.speaker: FEMUR
panels.dialogue: Then show me what you have learned.

panels.shot: Both fighters face one another.
panels.speaker: OPPONENT
panels.dialogue: Watch my feet.

femur_protagonist.title: No Exceptions
femur_protagonist.when: Femur selected: before either verified male protagonist

panels.shot: The selected male protagonist faces Femur in the arena.
panels.speaker: FEMUR
panels.dialogue: I have a challenge for you, too.

panels.shot: The protagonist holds his guard, unarmed.
panels.speaker: OPPONENT
panels.dialogue: You are determined to fight everyone.

panels.shot: Femur settles into her planted ginga.
panels.speaker: FEMUR
panels.dialogue: I am not leaving anyone out.

panels.shot: A wide face-off on a clear fighting floor.
panels.speaker: OPPONENT
panels.dialogue: Then let us play.

femur_other.title: Another Roda
femur_other.when: Femur selected: before any remaining non-student, non-protagonist opponent, including Aisha where applicable

panels.shot: The opponent enters an arena.
panels.speaker: OPPONENT
panels.dialogue: You have come a long way.

panels.shot: Femur studies the opponent without changing stance.
panels.speaker: FEMUR
panels.dialogue: And I have not finished.

panels.shot: Both fighters take their places.
panels.speaker: OPPONENT
panels.dialogue: You will have to earn the next step.

panels.shot: Femur raises her guard.
panels.speaker: FEMUR
panels.dialogue: I intend to.

challenge_femur.title: One More Rival
challenge_femur.when: Ordinary Arcade: after Aisha has been defeated, before opponent Femur

panels.shot: The victorious player enters Femur's arena. Femur is already waiting.
panels.speaker: FEMUR
panels.dialogue: You have finished your fight with Aisha. Not with me.

panels.shot: The player turns toward Femur.
panels.speaker: PLAYER
panels.dialogue: What do you want?

panels.shot: Femur moves into her guard.
panels.speaker: FEMUR
panels.dialogue: One more answer. From your feet, not your words.

panels.shot: Wide face-off, both in original Capoeira stances.
panels.speaker: PLAYER
panels.dialogue: Then enter the roda.

aisha_challenge_femur.title: Beyond the Androids
aisha_challenge_femur.when: Aisha special route: after every android fight, before Femur

panels.shot: Aisha stands after completing the android encounters. Femur enters the arena.
panels.speaker: FEMUR
panels.dialogue: You have finished fighting the androids.

panels.shot: Aisha studies her new opponent.
panels.speaker: AISHA
panels.dialogue: And you are not one of them.

panels.shot: Femur takes a grounded ginga stance.
panels.speaker: FEMUR
panels.dialogue: No. I fight with what I have learned.

panels.shot: Both combatants face each other.
panels.speaker: AISHA
panels.dialogue: Then show me.

femur_victory.title: A Rival Stands
femur_victory.when: Femur selected: final full-route victory only

panels.shot: Femur returns to ginga as the final opponent recovers.
panels.speaker: FEMUR
panels.dialogue: I have faced them all.

panels.shot: Femur looks across the empty fighting floor.
panels.speaker: FEMUR
panels.dialogue: But a victory is not the end of my training.

panels.shot: A quiet dressing room; her earned alternate Capoeira Angola uniform is ready.
panels.speaker: FEMUR
panels.dialogue: A new uniform. The same discipline.

panels.shot: Femur wearing her approved alternate original Angola costume; show her full body and stable proportions.
panels.caption: FEMUR — ALTERNATE COSTUME UNLOCKED

femur_defeat.title: Not Finished
femur_defeat.when: Femur selected: match loss that ends the route

panels.shot: Femur lies in her real defeat pose; opponent lowers their guard.
panels.speaker: OPPONENT
panels.dialogue: The match is over.

panels.shot: Femur rises using her recovery poses.
panels.speaker: FEMUR
panels.dialogue: I know.

panels.shot: Close on Femur as she straightens her headdress.
panels.speaker: FEMUR
panels.dialogue: I will study what I missed.

panels.shot: Femur leaves the arena on foot.
panels.caption: THE RIVAL WILL RETURN.

player_defeats_femur.title: The Answer
player_defeats_femur.when: Any other player, including Aisha, defeats Femur in the concluding match

panels.shot: Femur falls and the player returns to their stance.
panels.speaker: PLAYER
panels.dialogue: That is my answer.

panels.shot: Femur gets up without changing outfit or proportions.
panels.speaker: FEMUR
panels.dialogue: I heard it.

panels.shot: Both face one another with hands lowered.
panels.speaker: FEMUR
panels.dialogue: I have more to learn.

panels.shot: The player leaves as Femur returns to ginga.
panels.caption: RODA — THE CHALLENGE IS COMPLETE.

player_loses_to_femur.title: The Rival Remains
player_loses_to_femur.when: Any other player loses the concluding match against Femur

panels.shot: The player is knocked down. Femur returns to ginga.
panels.speaker: FEMUR
panels.dialogue: That is not the answer I was looking for.

panels.shot: The player recovers.
panels.speaker: PLAYER
panels.dialogue: This is not our last roda.

panels.shot: Femur gives a small, restrained nod.
panels.speaker: FEMUR
panels.dialogue: I will be here.

panels.shot: Femur remains in her stance on the arena floor.
panels.caption: RETURN AND TRY AGAIN.
